cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Can You Keep It?
cards.instruction: Use increasingly sensitive details to test whether someone deserves deeper trust.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I withdrew my college application. Have you told Mum?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She asked. I said my sister's plans were hers to explain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then there's more. I've leased a bakery. Can I send you the address?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Call me. Mum uses my tablet; she'd see the message.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good catch. I'll call. It's Mum's old bakery. I want you there when I tell her.

mechanism: A escalates a sibling's disclosures from withdrawn application to a family-sensitive bakery lease while supervising how the information is protected.
confusable: Warm disclosure alone lacks S03; corrections must arise from B's actual protective account and privacy constraints.
comparison: Sibling loyalty and Mum's history differ from controlling club supply-chain gossip.
seedUse: Use the college withdrawal, bakery lease and Mum's old shop; B's good privacy judgment should still matter.
